agent_priors_used: Agent prior, not SPIDER evidence: when a common infrastructure failure invalidates many downstream measurements, a small fail-closed substrate preflight usually has more option value than another full outcome-bearing experiment on the unavailable substrate.

Agent prior, not SPIDER evidence: parameterization is most credibly tested by training on one identifier population and evaluating on value-disjoint unseen identifiers, because same-family replay can otherwise masquerade as inheritance.

Agent prior, not SPIDER evidence: long-horizon systems benefit only when verification, freshness, and calibrated UNKNOWN are integrated with reuse; cost measured before those safety properties are valid can reward unsafe work reduction.

Agent prior, not SPIDER evidence: deterministic execution and compilation can have unusually strong amortization at high reuse, so a product-economics study should compare against strong execution baselines rather than retrieval alone.
Agent prior, not SPIDER evidence: after repeated identical instrument failures, parking a dependent thread can preserve more research value than spending another cycle to rediscover the same blocker.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Another full C1-C8 composite would repeat the known failure and mix infrastructure readiness with multiple scientific questions. Re-running distributed HTTP work would add little because that ceiling is already retained. The narrow preflight has the highest immediate option value even with a 65-claim streak because it changes the readiness of four downstream lanes rather than adding another C-MEAS-VALID data point.
allocation.question: Can a fail-closed provisioning preflight launch the pinned public Playwright Chromium, capture a genuine 1280x720 DOM and full accessibility tree over CDP, and demonstrate one reversible authenticated SPA write with before/after WAL evidence while read-only, invalid-auth, expired-auth, and deleted-session controls leave the WAL unchanged, with no synthetic fallback?
allocation.rationale: Runtime is the portfolio's critical blocker: the last full composite failed before browser capture, leaving browser, writable, and k-means claims UNKNOWN while preserving only the audited plain-HTTP ceiling. A preflight isolates provisioning and writable-control validity before another expensive scientific composite. Its positive result unblocks Graph, Product, Physics, and Frontier; its bounded negative identifies the exact executable/version/helper failure without being misreported as a mechanism falsification.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER currently has a narrow validated measurement ceiling for distributed plain-HTTP localhost substrate, but no measurement-valid browser/writable-control evidence and no end-to-end real-agent demonstration of inherited work compression. The highest-leverage new work is therefore a fail-closed Runtime browser provisioning preflight, paired with a Graph A-to-B parameterized-inheritance test on the already validated HTTP substrate. Product and Frontier should not consume more cycles on browser-dependent end-to-end or compilation experiments while the same substrate blocker remains. The frozen Intel diverse-site census and frozen Physics correlated-branching CMI experiment must finish unchanged. This sequencing restores measurement and mechanism evidence before asking Product to test economics and before reopening Frontier on a real held-out corpus.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout brief materially changed the portfolio by sharpening the browser-provisioning bottleneck, the starvation of C-PARAM-INHERIT and C-FRESHNESS, Frontier's local-attractor warning, and Product's lack of valid external-agent economics. I adopted its Runtime-first and Graph-to-C-PARAM-INHERIT suggestions, while treating its WebChoreArena, memory, and compilation findings as unverified external context rather than SPIDER evidence. I rejected its suggestion to launch more browser-dependent Frontier or Product work now: Frontier's main alternative would duplicate the frozen Physics program, and Product lacks the audited capabilities needed for a meaningful end-to-end test. The already-frozen Intel and Physics directions are continued solely to satisfy transaction discipline, not because this cycle re-endorses their inherited breadth.
